definitions.explanation: A particular part or feature of something, often used to discuss different perspectives or characteristics.
The outer part or exterior of something.

examples.japanese: マイナス{面|めん}を{考|かんが}える。
{経済|けいざい}{面|めん}では{問題|もんだい}がある。
examples.english: There are problems in terms of the economy.

notes:
{面|めん} has two main uses: as a noun meaning "surface" or "face," and as a suffix meaning "aspect" or "in terms of."

AS A SUFFIX ("aspect"):
This is the most common usage. It attaches to nouns to mean "in terms of" or "regarding."
- {精神|せいしん}{面|めん}: mental aspect
- {経済|けいざい}{面|めん}: economic aspect
- {安全|あんぜん}{面|めん}: safety aspect
- {健康|けんこう}{面|めん}: health aspect
- プラス{面|めん}: positive side
- マイナス{面|めん}: negative side

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{面|めん}では: in terms of ~
- 〜の{面|めん}から{見|み}ると: looking at it from the ~ perspective
- 〜{面|めん}で{優|すぐ}れている: to excel in the ~ aspect
- あらゆる{面|めん}で: in every respect

AS A NOUN ("surface"):
- {表面|ひょうめん}: surface
- {路面|ろめん}: road surface
- {水面|すいめん}: water surface
